description: staging_fallback.rs fetch_from_staging() does a SELECT file_path then a tokio::fs::read(&file_path). If the transit drain task deletes the staging file between these two operations, read() returns an ENOENT error and the function returns StagingResult::Error, causing a 430. A warn! is emitted but the client sees a confusing 500-style 'program fault'. Given the staging window is short (milliseconds to seconds), this TOCTOU is rare but predictable under load. Document it, or use ATTACH approach to read via file descriptor held open by the transit process.
title: reader/staging_fallback: no test for concurrent transit drain deleting file between SELECT and read()
